Old wounds resurface, reigniting his thirst for revenge and escalating the battle between good and evil. Umut Aral, Damla Serim, Aras Bulut Iynemli, Ugur Polat, Taner Ölmez, Onur Saylak, Melis Sezen.

programme.title: Crossroads
programme.desc: After her husband, Omar, is accused in several cases and imprisoned, the determined and resolute Amira is forced to return to her legal profession to provide for her children, paving the way for a new life. Mohamed Yahia Moro.

programme.title: The Family
programme.desc: Not only does coincidence bring together the mysterious businessman Aslan and psychotherapist Devin, but they also share the same psychological traumas caused by their families. Therefore, they try to establish a life together despite the suffering. Kivanç Tatlitug, Serenay Sarikaya, Nur Surer, Nejat Isler, Canan Erguder, Ahmet Katiksiz, Hakan Bonomo, Kivanc Tatlitug.

programme.title: Dream
programme.desc: Show Providing assistance or fulfilling wishes of people who are experiencing difficult circumstances or have ambitions and dreams that have not yet been fulfilled by providing the necessary support and opportunities.

programme.title: Manna'ah
programme.desc: In the 1980s, Gharam, a mother of three, enters the drug trade after her husband, who was involved in it, is killed. She quickly rises to become one of the most powerful drug lords, but she faces the consequences of her choices when she is exposed. Hend Sabry, Khaled Selim.

programme.title: Bad Environment
programme.desc: Bullied for his hearing and speech impairments and denied the chance to marry the woman he loves, Hassan breaks free from a life of rejection and takes a job at Kuwait's stock exchange, hoping to forge a different future. Ramadan Khasrouh.
